description: ["draft": true] DRAFT - shape may change before it is published. Per-community configuration for an Authority One community: access tier, directory listing, header theme, brand, optional agent and moderation routing. Singleton (key: self) in the repo hosting the community's com.authorityone.group.profile. Holds public configuration only: members-tier posts have NO lexicon and never touch a repo.

community.description: Strong reference to the com.authorityone.group.profile this config applies to.

listing.description: Whether the community appears in the directory. Defaults to listed if absent.

agent.description: DID of the community's agent account, if any. Clients label agent content from this DID plus the runtime is_agent flag, never from a handle suffix.

agentSponsor.description: DID of the account accountable for the agent. Required when agent is set (enforced by the AppView; lexicon cannot express conditional requirements).

ageNotice.description: Optional age notice shown before entry.

consentVersion.description: Version of the consent wording members agree to. Matches the tenant ledger's wording_version.

theme.description: Community header theme. Applied to the community header only, never as a whole-app reskin.

wordmark.description: Text wordmark shown in the community header.

labelers.description: DIDs of labeler services applied to this community.

reportTo.description: DID of the moderation service that receives reports for this community.

members.description: Readable by effective members only. Members content is served off-protocol and never written to a PDS.

paid.description: Members tier gated by a paid entitlement.
